integrity: The source endpoint data and profile ODE are used as published premises. The new two-term asymptotics follow by direct asymptotic integration and exact projective inversion; finite symbolic checks are consistency tests only and are not used as proof.
scientific limitations: The result treats the canonical radial equality representative for \(n\ge2\). It does not give a closed form for \(a_n\), a noise-stable inverse statement, or stability for near-extremizers. The effective-domain conclusion is exact; no quantitative boundary blow-up rate for the Legendre dual is claimed.
title: Two-end asymptotics of the nonquadratic sharp functional Santaló extremizer
